arabic_text: إِلـٰهِي أَذْهَلَنِي عَنْ إِقامَةِ شُكْرِكَ تَتابُعُ طَوْلِكَ،
transliteration: ilaahee ad'-halanee a'n-iqaamati shuk-rika tataabuu' t'aw-lik
english_text: My God, the continuous flow of Your graciousness has distracted me from setting up the thanksgiving due to You!

arabic_text: وَأَعْجَزَنِي عَنْ إِحْصاءِ ثَنائِكَ فَيْضُ فَضْلِكَ،
transliteration: wa aa'-jazanee a'n-ih'-s'aaa-i thanaaa-ika fayz''u faz''-lik
english_text: The outpouring of Your bounty has rendered me incapable of counting Your praises!

arabic_text: وَشَغَلَنِي عَنْ ذِكْرِ مَآثِرِكَ تَوالي آلائِكَ،
transliteration: wa shaghananee a'n-d'ik-ri maaathirika tawaalee aaalaaa-ik
english_text: The succession of Your benefits has diverted me from mentioning the beautiful traits of Your generosity!

arabic_text: وَأَعْيَانِي عَنْ نَشْرِ عَوارِفِكَ تَرادُفُ عَوائِدِكَ،
transliteration: wa aa'-yaanee a'n-nash-ri a'waarifika taraadufu a'waaa-idik
english_text: The abundant arrival of Your kind acts has made me fail in spreading the mention of Your kind favours!

arabic_text: هذا مَقامُ مَنِ اعْتَرَفَ بِسُبُوغِ النَّعْماءِ،
english_text: This is the station of him who confesses the plentifulness of favours,
but meets them with shortcomings,
and bears witness against himself to negligence and wastefulness!
You are the Gentle, the Merciful, the Devout, the Generous,
who disappoints not those who seek Him,
nor drives away those who hope for what is with Him!
In Your courtyard the hopes of the hopeful alight,
and in Your open plain the expectations of those who seek help halt.
So meet not our hopes with disappointment and despair,
and clothe us not in the shirt of despair and hopelessness!

arabic_text: إِلـٰهِي تَصاغَرَ عِنْدَ تَعاظُمِ آلائِكَ شُكْرِي،
transliteration: ilaahee tas'aaghara i'nda taa'aaz'umi aaalaaa-ika shuk-ree
english_text: My God, my thanksgiving is small before the magnitude of Your gifts,

arabic_text: وَتَضاءَلَ فِي جَنْبِ إِكْرامِكَ إِيَّايَ ثَنائِي وَنَشْرِي،
transliteration: wa taz''aaa-ala fee janbi ik-raamika ee-yaaya thanaaa-ee wa nash-ree
english_text: my praise and spoken description diminish beside Your generosity toward me!

arabic_text: آلاؤُكَ جَمَّةٌ ضَرَبَتْ عَلىٰ لِسانِي كِلالاً نِعَمُكَ كَثِيرَةٌ قَصَرَتْ عَنْ إِحْصائِها فَهْمِي،
transliteration: aaalaaa-uka jam-matun z''arabat a'laa lisaanee kilaalan nia'muka katheeratun qas'arat a'n-ih'-s'aaa-ihhaa fah-mee
english_text: Your benefits are abundant, my tongue is too weak to count them, and Your favours are numerous beyond my understanding!

arabic_text: فَكَيْفَ لِي بِتَحْصِيلِ الشُّكْرِ وَشُكْرِي إيَّاكَ يَفْتَقِرُ إلىٰ شُكْرٍ،
transliteration: fakay-fa lee bitah'-s'eelish-shuk-ri wa shuk-ree ee-yaaka yaf-taqiru ilaa shuk-r
english_text: How can I gain thanksgiving, when my thanksgiving to You requires thanksgiving?

arabic_text: فَكُلَّما قُلْتُ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَجَبَ عَلَيَّ لِذالِكَ أَنْ أَقُولَ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ.
transliteration: fakul-lamaa qul-tu lakal-h'amdu wajaba a'lay-ya lid'alika an aqoola lakal-h'amd
english_text: Whenever I say, 'To You belongs praise', it becomes thereby incumbent upon me to say, 'To You belongs praise'!
My God, just as You have nourished us with Your gentleness
and nurtured us with Your beneficence,
so complete for us the plentiful blessings,
repel from us the evil blows of vengeance,

arabic_text: وَآتِنا مِنْ حُظُوظِ الدَّارَيْنِ أَرْفَعَها وَأَعْلاها،
transliteration: wa aa-tina min h'uz'ooz'id-daarayni ar-faa'ahaa wa aa'-laahaa
english_text: and give us the highest and most exalted share of both abodes!

arabic_text: إِلـٰهِي لَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلىٰ حُسْنِ قَضائِكَ،
english_text: My God, to You belongs praise for Your good decree,
and for what You have turned away from me of Your trial!

arabic_text: فَلا تَجْعَلْ حَظّـِي مِنْ رَحْمَتِكَ ما عَجَّلْتَ لِي مِنْ عافِيَةِ ما أَنا أَهْلُهُ،
transliteration: fala taj-a'l h'az'z''ee min rah'-matika maa a'j-jalta lee min aafiyati maaa ana ah-luh
english_text: Do not let my share of Your mercy be only the quick recovery which You have granted me from the affliction I deserve,
lest I be wretched through what I love,
while others be happy through what I dislike!

arabic_text: وَإنْ يَكُنْ ما لا أَحْتَسِبُهُ مِنَ النَّوائِبِ حُلُولاً،
transliteration: wa in yakun maa laa ah'-tasibahoo minan-nawaaa-ibi h'uloolan
english_text: And if the afflictions I have not reckoned with should befall,
